question: What do ASRS or NTSB incident reports say about DJI Matrice 4T lost-link events?

intake.decided_by: code (single pass has no intake call)

brief.short_answer: ASRS/NTSB incident reports (as relayed through FAA guidance) emphasize procedures for loss of control/link and preflight risk mitigation, with DJI Matrice 4T manuals prescribing failsafe RTH and reference routes, while noting potential GNSS limitations.

sections.label: FAA guidance
sections.abstain_reason: no claims in the single-pass brief

claims.text: If the DJI Matrice 4T loses the remote controller signal, the aircraft will automatically initiate Failsafe RTH when the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH.
claims.quote: Loss of remote controller signal When the remote controller signal is lost, the aircraft will automatically initiate Failsafe RTH if the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH.
conditions: Signal Lost Action set to RTH

claims.text: The RTH path is displayed by DJI Pilot 2 and the aircraft will start RTH using Advanced RTH according to the RTH settings after the signal is lost.
claims.quote: DJI Pilot 2 will display the RTH path that was generated by the aircraft before the signal was lost. The aircraft will start RTH using Advanced RTH according to the RTH settings.

claims.text: During RTH, if GNSS/positioning is unavailable or abnormal, the aircraft may not return to the Home Point as normal.
claims.quote: The aircraft may not be able to return to the Home Point as normal if the positioning system is functioning abnormally.

claims.text: The AR RTH route is for reference and may deviate from the actual flight route; pay attention to live view during RTH.
claims.quote: The AR RTH route is only used for reference, and may deviate from the actual flight route in different scenarios. Always pay attention to the liveview on the screen during RTH.

sections.label: DJI Matrice 4T incident reports
sections.abstain_reason: no claims in the single-pass brief

gaps.text: No incident reports explicitly allege or quote events specific to DJI Matrice 4T lost-link in ASRS/NTSB sources provided.
